name: Venomtail Poison Sac
summary: A Venomtail Poison Sac is a biological organ harvested from scorpids native to the arid expanses of Durotar. While containing a virulent toxin capable of incapacitating an unwary hunter, it is also the vital ingredient required to brew an effective counter-agent.

sections.title: A Deadly Toxin and Its Remedy
sections.body: The scorpids prowling the red rocks of Durotar—chiefly the Venomtail Scorpid, alongside mutated varieties like the Corrupted Scorpid and the notorious Death Flayer—produce a fast-acting, debilitating venom. Stored within specialized tail sacs, this poison can quickly overwhelm even seasoned warriors if left untreated. Ironically, the very sacs that deliver this lethal sting contain the primary compounds necessary to synthesize an antidote. When the hunter Rhinag fell victim to a sting outside Orgrimmar, local alchemists required four fresh poison sacs to concoct the remedy needed to neutralize the venom coursing through his veins.

faq.q: What creatures carry these poison sacs?
aliases: where to get venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: They are harvested from scorpids in Durotar, primarily the Venomtail Scorpids found roaming near the outskirts of Orgrimmar, as well as Corrupted Scorpids and the rare Death Flayer.

faq.q: What is the poison sac used for?
aliases: why do i need venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: The sacs are brought to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar to distill a specialized antidote. This cure is urgently needed to treat the hunter Rhinag, who was stung and poisoned while hunting without proper preparation.

faq.q: Who can brew the antidote from these sacs?
aliases: where to turn in venomtail sacs
faq.answer: Kor'ghan, located within Orgrimmar, knows the proper method to refine the raw venom from four intact sacs into a curative draft before the poison proves fatal.

angles.text: Young Horde adventurers learning the harsh realities of Durotar quickly discover that survival requires understanding the wildlife, as local toxins can easily kill those who rush unprepared into the red wastes.
Rhinag's misfortune serves as an object lesson for hunters: pursuing dangerous beasts without understanding their venom or carrying proper remedies beforehand can easily cost a tracker their life.
